name: Heavy flail
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 15 gp Weight 10 lbs.
Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range —; Type B; Special disarm, trip
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Flails
Description
Similar to a light flail, a heavy flail has a larger metal ball and a longer handle.
